title: Band of Berserkers , Updated the UI. Still need to work on the arena battle look and feel.
author: Practical-Raccoon-88
selftext:
Autobattler game.

Manage bunch of Vikings to take over the realm. Defeat arena gladiatorial battles, buy new items, level up fighters, learn skills, choose formation, higher difficulty battles, yield better loot. 

  
I updated the main UI screens. I am sure this is better than before. 

Any feedback will be appreciated.

comments.author: lostforever2011
comments.body:
Looks nice and thanks for sharing pls?

I would like to write game like the above as hobby project with AI. Do you mind telling your workflow pls? Thx

replies.author: Practical-Raccoon-88
replies.body:
Hi Thanks,  
There is a lot going on with this game from a workflow perspective. 

The main actual characters is made on my Desktop PC - Using Comfyui - QWEN 2511 fb, with lighting lora 4 step, with prompt to make them pixel art style.  
then I use image to video AI models to make small videos with blank backgrounds. Like walk, idle, attack.   
then I run the video on website to make frames of the video [https://ezgif.com/video-to-jpg](https://ezgif.com/video-to-jpg)

Run each image through another website to remove the backgrounds.

[https://bgeraser.com/](https://bgeraser.com/)

  
Then I import those images as frames in the game engine. Trigger the animations in the code.

  
For the weapons, I make progressively better equipment sprites in Comfyui. (same as the main characters). Then in code I just call the sprite that is associated with the equipment quality to match.

I do all the coding myself. Rarely use AI to assist with code.

I generate all the skills in one promt to ensure similarity - same vibe/art style.

I also use Chatgpt/Grok/Gemini from time to time to make small little images i might need.

  
Hope that gives you an idea
